w004_52_1659.summary: News from the imperial court: the president of the Aulic Council, Count Oettingen, and Prince Auersperg say the court will keep the word the Emperor gave in writing from Frankfurt and the Prince (the Prince-Bishop of Münster) will have the judgement for himself without any condition of Doctor Batz; 700 Reichstaler promised to the referent von Lindenspür are to be transferred; postscript: everything was concluded today in the secret council in the Prince's favour with no condition attached.
w004_52_1659.en:
- P1: [I have] understood [this] from the president, Count Oettingen.
- P2: [that one] will keep the word that the Emperor gave in writing from Frankfurt.
- P3: Prince Auersperg [said] that the Prince will have the judgement in his favour, without any condition of
Doctor Batz. ("quo{b/d}": the signs give quob, read quod.)
- P4: to transfer the seven hundred Reichstaler promised to the referent von Lindenspür.
- P5: Everything was concluded today in the secret council in favour of the Prince, with no condition attached.
